title: Mouse holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M 62 28 Q 58 40 62 52' stroke='#f5e6b8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='18' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#e84040'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='18' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff7060' opacity='0.3'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='13' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffb0a0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='62,32 60,35 64,35' fill='#c03030'/>
  <!-- Mouse body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#a0a8b8'/>
  <!-- Mouse belly -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='72' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#d8dde8'/>
  <!-- Mouse head -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='12' fill='#a0a8b8'/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='8' fill='#a0a8b8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='42' r='5' fill='#f0a0b0'/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='8' fill='#a0a8b8'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='5' fill='#f0a0b0'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='50' r='3' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='49' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#f06080'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='18' y1='53' x2='10' y2='51' stroke='#c0c8d8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='56' x2='10' y2='57' stroke='#c0c8d8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='59' x2='11' y2='63' stroke='#c0c8d8' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M 28 58 Q 31 61 33 58' stroke='#c0c8d8' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Arm holding string -->
  <path d='M 55 65 Q 60 58 62 52' stroke='#a0a8b8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Paw -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='3' fill='#f0a0b0'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M 55 78 Q 65 82 68 75 Q 70 70 65 68' stroke='#f0a0b0' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='82' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#f0a0b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='82' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#f0a0b0'/>
</svg>
